439528891.body: new smart runtime. the runtime now adapts to the game. it starts small grows while the game reads, and gives its threads back at once when the game needs them. this works in every game, packed or not faster open-world games. the pack caches are twice as large, so games that stream a big world keep more of it in memory fix launch and in-game freezes. a game no longer goes black at launch or freezes when it cannot start a thread of its own because the runtime s threads took the room. crimson desert 13 hit this at launch and at the main menu save fixes. crimson desert 13, 30 no longer hangs when loading a save. saves load, new saves work and videos play, from a plain folder and from a zstd pack debug build new get queues page: event queue waits, pending events and ampr targets metrics adds apr wait and submit gauges, error events, signal type and aio id counters, and the thread budget zstd frames are checked against their checksum the release build skips this thanks a big thank you to everyone who stayed with 13 to the end: luminusalk who opened it and tested build after build, jamesst20, whose tables of working and failing settings found the thread problem, and eduardoalvarez7, addictiontoplay and sharppg45-oss for their runs and reports thanks again to jamesst20 for helping other reporters in 35, 36 and 37 welcome to everyone who reported a game for the first time tnnuy23-dot 34, 40 , kinggslayerr 35, 37 , dlangamer 38 ramorym-bit 39 and mrfireos 41 , and welcome back majimagorosandesu 36 reporting a game issues have a game report form. please share how your games run, both the ones that fail and the ones that work how to use copy libsceampr.sprx into the game s fakelib and mount the game with shadowmountplus disable fakelib update in settings zstd and lz4 packs can be made by ps5-dump-forge

441465055.body: fixes saves: starting a new game over an existing save no longer hangs on the loading screen. your saves are not destroyed - thay was just not able to load lean runtime: games are run smoother than before thanks a big thank you to jamesst20, who wrote the save fixes and the pread idle fix in this release 46 , tracked the new-game hang and the packed save icon down in 13, and left a working build there for everyone waiting thanks to marczito, rahulsinghal97s, redcowboy85 and lautaronf, who hit the same save problem in 13, tested the builds and confirmed the fix, and to eduardoalvarez7 and sharppg45-oss for staying with it welcome to everyone who reported a game for the first time robertocarlos3162005-creator 43 , shree1521 44 , fecent 45 and dvnipena 47 , and welcome back betelopson 42 reporting a game issues have a game report form. please share how your games run, both the ones that fail and the ones that work how to use copy libsceampr.sprx into the game s fakelib and mount the game with shadowmountplus disable fakelib update in its settings zstd and lz4 packs can be made with ps5-dump-forge

439593709.body: new custom output names. the about tab has a new output names card for how generated names look. type any text and insert the parts you want: title, title id, version, pack kind, region and firmware, each at most once english titles in names. generated names use the game s english title when it has one, so a game whose default language is japanese is named astro bot - ppsa01234 instead of アストロボット - ppsa01234 . a game whose default language is english keeps its own title ampr-emu-ng v0.3.4. the bundled runtime is the v0.3.4 release. upstream fixes since v0.3.2: the runtime sizes its threads to the game, so a game no longer goes black at launch or freezes when it can t start a thread of its own fixes ini files are never packed, in zstd and lz4 packs and under custom toml rules alike, so dlc emu.ini and other settings stay editable after packing verifying a pack written from a mac or pc to the ps5 read far more than it needed: every packed file over 2 mib pulled a 64 mib window, and one 20 gb pack took about 90 minutes to verify. reads now start small and grow while they stay sequential delete the source failed on a windows exfat or fat drive with the volume reports no file ids . the drive s root folder has no file id on those file systems, and it is now accepted for the root only a name worked out after another job started could take that job s name, and the next job then failed on it. names now count every job started since thanks lucaszhongsj made their first contribution in 39, which brought english titles to generated names and stopped hidden tabs from renaming their output on every template change jamesst20 asked for the version and pack kind in names in 33, which became the output names card nisec-eric reported the slow verify in 36, and linkultima the failing delete on windows in 34
